input.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask you, or call Harel, because the page shows a huge list of Harel tracks (it says "105") and I can't tell which one my money is in or which of them is as safe as a deposit. The only things I took away are that most of the fees look like about half a percent a year, and in the pension ones there's also a 1.47% charge on what goes in.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the top of the table
stuck.why: Black background, and right away a wall of numbers and circles. I went on only because I came to see Harel's things, but my eyes were already tired.

stuck.where: Column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number. I couldn't work out whether that means there's no return or something else. And it says 'לפני דמי ניהול', so is that what I actually get, or less?

stuck.where: Column 'דמי ניהול' with two lines, 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות'
stuck.why: In קופת גמל the deposit fee is 0%, but in קרן פנסיה it's 0.16% and also 1.47%. I don't know whether to add them together or which one counts.

stuck.where: The coloured circles next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח'
stuck.why: The green and the yellow look alike to me, and I didn't understand what 99% מניות and 99% מט"ח together mean. It frightened me: that sounds like everything is in shares.
I'd had enough. After 'קרנות מחקות' I stopped.

The sentence under the table: 'היא לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך'

findings.what: A black screen packed with numbers, percentages and circles. It made me anxious from the very first screen.
Nowhere does it say in plain words which track is safe, or which one suits someone who doesn't want to take a risk.
Two fee lines, plus a 1.47% on deposits in the pension, and no explanation of what I actually pay.
'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number in many rows. Confusing.
The grey text in the column headings and the footnotes is too small and too faint for me.
findings.where: The table header, and the bottom of screen 5

findings.what: Green and yellow circles that look the same to me
English letters such as S&P 500 and PF-06
It's very long. I only got through five screens.
